# `vl new`

Start a new change on top of REVS (default: @). Several = merge

```text
vl new [OPTIONS] [REVS]...
```

Arguments:

| | |
|---|---|
| `<REVS>…` | Parents of the new change |

Options:

| | |
|---|---|
| `-m, --message <MESSAGE>` | Description of the new change (default: empty) |
